text: A Book has a title, an isbn and a published year. An Author has a name. Each Book belongs to one Author.
A Customer has a name and an email. A Customer has many Orders. An Order has a total and a created at.
A Student has a first name, a last name, and an email. A Course has a title and credits. Many Students relate to many Courses.
A Category has a name. A Category has many Products. A Product has a name, a price and a stock.
A Team has a name. Each Player belongs to one Team. A Player has a name and a jersey number.
A Blog Post has a title, a body and a published at. An Author has a display name. Each Blog Post belongs to one Author. A Blog Post has many Comments. A Comment has a body.
A Warehouse has a city. A Warehouse has many Boxes. A Box has a label and a weight.

A Patient has a name and a birth date. A Doctor has a name and a specialty. An Appointment has a scheduled at and a reason. Each Appointment belongs to one Patient. Each Appointment belongs to one Doctor.
Many Tags relate to many Articles. An Article has a headline. A Tag has a label.
A Company has a name. A Company has many Employees. An Employee has an email. Each Employee belongs to one Department. A Department has a name and a budget.
A User has a username. Many Users relate to many Groups. A Group has a name and a description.

An Invoice has a number, an issued on and an amount. Each Invoice belongs to one Client. A Client has a company name. An Invoice has many Line Items. A Line Item has a description, a quantity and a unit price.
